title: Learner Request Notifications
description: Choose which roles are told when a learner, during a test, reports a problem with a question, asks for more time, or asks for another attempt. By default only admins are notified. Every request also appears in the test's Learner Requests tab.

inApp.label: Dashboard bell and app push
inApp.hint: Shows in the notification bell and on the staff app.

email.label: Email
email.hint: One email per request. When many learners report the same question, staff hear about it once in 10 minutes.

nobodyWarning: No one will be notified. Learner requests will only appear in the Learner Requests tab.
